key_impacts: Harbor walls were overtopped in Ludington.
Shoreline homes and public docks/cottages were damaged.
Water intake pumps were impacted due to large water-level changes.
The nearest coastal water-level gauge inside the harbor recorded fluctuations up to 0.5 m.
NWS received reports of about 2 m water-level fluctuations along the coastline just outside the harbor; no injuries or fatalities were reported.
missing_information: Number of damaged structures and overall losses not quantified.
